laws.t: Regulation No. 90 of 2009 on Domestic Workers, Cooks, Gardeners and Similar Categories
laws.tp: Hours, weekly rest, leave and payment under the Labour Law.
laws.s2: Mengatur jam kerja, libur mingguan, cuti, dan pembayaran upah pekerja rumah tangga, juru masak, dan tukang kebun.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Domestic workers brought under the Labour Law in 2008, with a dedicated regulation.
coded.src: Labour Law 8/1996 art. 3 as amended 2008; Regulation 90/2009

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Unified tripartite contract in Arabic and the worker's language.

coded.vl: A separate or lower minimum, or one set only by policy
coded.n: Excluded from the national minimum wage; minimums set by bilateral arrangement per nationality.

coded.vl: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
coded.n: Monthly payment, by bank transfer where possible.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
coded.n: Withholding another person's passport is an offence.

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: Recruitment offices may not charge workers.

coded.vl: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
coded.n: Licensed offices; liability in the first months.

coded.vl: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only

agreements.t: Memorandum of Understanding on Domestic Workers
Memorandum of Understanding on Domestic Workers
agreements.sc: Employer pays recruitment costs; standard contract.
